test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements: All lions are tigers. Some tigers are leopard. No leopard is giraffe. Conclusions: (I) Some leopards are lions. (II) Some giraffe can be tigers
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae865c03a23494ec0edb4498539b5a20ec580fb33ad0af6893291796955e6bce.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some leopards are lions. → Does not follow (As all lions are tigers and some tigers are leopard. So it is possible but not definite)

(II) Some giraffe can be tigers → **F**ollow (As some tigers are leopard and no leopard is giraffe. As no statement restricts from some giraffes being tigers, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
